description_en: Releases the public endpoint of an instance that runs RDS Cluster Edition
description_zh: 该接口用于释放RDS集群系列实例的Endpoint的外网连接地址
kebab_example: aliyun rds delete-db-instance-endpoint-address --client-token 6000170000591aed949d0f0000 --db-instance-id rm-0000 --db-instance-endpoint-id ep-0000 --connection-string new0000.mysql.rds.aliyuncs.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDBInstanceEndpointAddress

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
该参数用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。参数值由客户端生成，保证在不同请求间唯一。

该参数值由ASCII字符组成，最长不超过64个字符，不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The endpoint ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceEndpoints operation to query the endpoint ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例的Endpoint ID。可调用DescribeDBInstanceEndpoints查询
parameters.name: db_instance_endpoint_id
